details:
Q1
Which specific repo area should be changed?
Choices:
A. One named workflow, script, or file path, plus the current problem you want fixed. (RECOMMENDED)
B. One named pipeline phase (`clarify`, `plan`, `implement`, `review/autofix`, `orchestrate`, or `validate`), plus the exact behavior to improve. (RECOMMENDED)
C. A documentation-only change, plus the doc file or section that should be improved.
Q2
What concrete outcome should the change produce?
Choices:
A. Fix a current bug or regression — describe the current wrong behavior and the expected behavior after the fix. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability, safety, or performance — describe the pain point or failure mode and what should improve. (RECOMMENDED)
C. Improve wording, docs, or usability — describe exactly what should read or behave differently.
Q3
How should we tell that the task is complete?
Choices:
A. Give one concrete acceptance example (input/output, log line, workflow result, or visible behavior). (RECOMMENDED)
B. Point to a failing run, issue, PR, or error message that this should address. (RECOMMENDED)
C. If there is no failing example, give a specific before/after description that can be verified.
